title: Provider-neutral harness seam and the dsh adapter
summary: Adds a provider-neutral `harness` module (the `Harness` and `CommandRunner` traits, plain-data task/result/capability types, prompt building and the `QUESTION:` line contract) plus an in-memory fake, and the first concrete adapter, `dsh_harness`, which runs `dsh --profile headless --json -` through a `CommandRunner`, parses newline-delimited JSON events, guards the repository with git status/head/branch probes, and reports capabilities by probing `--version`, headless `--help` and `--dump-config`. Nothing in the neutral module names a harness or a model vendor; a test enforces that boundary.

lanes.label: Neutral harness seam
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/harness
lanes.summary: Provider-neutral traits and plain data: no harness, command or model vendor is named here.

lanes.label: Concrete adapters
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/dsh_harness.rs
lanes.summary: The dsh adapter: builds commands, parses events, guards the repository, probes capabilities.

lanes.label: External processes
lanes.subtitle: dsh and git
lanes.summary: The tools the adapter drives through a CommandRunner; the adapter starts none of them itself.

lanes.label: Tests and fixtures
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf/tests

nodes.label: harness::mod
nodes.subtitle: Harness, CommandRunner, HarnessTask, HarnessResult
nodes.summary: Defines the seam: CommandSpec/CommandOutput/CommandOutcome, the CommandRunner and Harness traits, HarnessTask, Actor, Usage, HarnessOutcome, HarnessResult, Capability, HarnessCapabilities and HarnessError. Also carries build_prompt, the RULES list and question_line.

nodes.label: harness::fake
nodes.subtitle: FakeRunner, FakeHarness
nodes.summary: In-memory doubles that replay scripted answers and record every command and task as plain data, starting no process.

nodes.label: Prompt + QUESTION: contract
nodes.subtitle: build_prompt / question_line
nodes.summary: Appends the four task rules to the task text, and reads a question only from the last non-blank line of the final message when it starts with `QUESTION:`.

nodes.label: DshHarness
nodes.subtitle: impl Harness for DshHarness
nodes.summary: The concrete adapter. Rejects empty tasks and dirty trees, runs the agent, parses events, checks the head did not move, and reports capabilities from three probes.

nodes.label: Command builders
nodes.subtitle: build_command, status/head/branch, probe_command
nodes.summary: Pure functions that produce the CommandSpec for the agent run, the three git probes and the dsh capability probes. git_env narrows the environment to PATH, HOME and GIT_*.

nodes.label: parse_events
nodes.subtitle: newline-delimited JSON → Parsed
nodes.summary: Reduces the run's JSONL events to session id, final message, summed token usage and the first non-completed turn reason. A non-JSON line is an error naming its line number.

nodes.label: parse_changed_files / parse_head / parse_branch
nodes.subtitle: porcelain -z and rev-parse readers
nodes.summary: Turns `git status --porcelain=v1 -z` into sorted, deduplicated repository-relative paths (including a rename's original path), and trims rev-parse output, treating a detached `HEAD` as no branch.

nodes.label: Capability probes
nodes.subtitle: probe_version / probe_headless / probe_stop_hook
nodes.summary: Runs `--version`, headless `--help` and `--dump-config` in order, each gated on the previous, and maps the results to Supported/Unsupported/Unknown. message_check_in reads the plugin row from the dump.

nodes.label: osf::lib
nodes.subtitle: pub mod harness; pub mod dsh_harness;
nodes.summary: Registers the two new modules on the crate root.

nodes.label: dsh
nodes.subtitle: --profile headless --json -
nodes.summary: The external coding harness. It reads the prompt on stdin and writes newline-delimited JSON events to stdout; it reports no model name and no cost figure.

nodes.label: git
nodes.subtitle: status / rev-parse
nodes.summary: Used only for the clean-tree check, the head commit and the branch. It receives the minimal environment, so no credential reaches it.

nodes.label: harness_fake_run
nodes.subtitle: full run + capability report
nodes.summary: Drives a whole run and a capability report through the trait objects with FakeRunner, asserting the exact command sequence, the parsed result and every capability outcome.

nodes.label: harness_neutral
nodes.subtitle: vendor-name scanner
nodes.summary: Asserts the neutral folder holds exactly mod.rs and fake.rs and names no supported agent, container word or model vendor, and proves the scanner can fail by pointing it at dsh_harness.rs.

nodes.label: dsh event fixtures
nodes.subtitle: *.jsonl, version, help, dump-config
nodes.summary: Recorded dsh output: a created-file run, a question run, four question-prose variants, a missing-credential failure, the version line, the headless help and a full profile dump.

edges.label: impl Harness
edges.summary: The adapter implements the neutral trait, so the engine can hold it as a `dyn Harness`.
Every command the adapter runs is produced by a pure builder.
The agent's stdout is reduced to a Parsed before any decision is made.
Status, head and branch output are parsed by these functions.
capabilities() delegates to the three probes.
The prompt is built with build_prompt and the outcome decided by question_line.

edges.label: CommandRunner
edges.summary: The adapter never starts a process itself; it hands a CommandSpec to the runner, which runs dsh.

edges.label: minimal env
edges.summary: Three git probes bracket the run: clean tree, head and branch before; status and head after.

edges.label: impl CommandRunner + Harness
edges.summary: The fakes implement both traits so tests can drive the seam without a process.
The integration test scripts the fakes and inspects what they recorded.
The same test file exercises the concrete adapter through the same trait objects.
Fixtures are included at compile time and replayed as scripted stdout.

edges.label: reads source
edges.summary: The scanner reads the neutral folder's files and asserts no banned word appears.

edges.label: negative control
edges.summary: Points the vendor scanner at dsh_harness.rs to prove it can fail.
`pub mod harness` makes the seam reachable from the crate root.
`pub mod dsh_harness` exposes the concrete adapter.
